creator: thesojournersfamily
title: A family lists five non-coding ways they use Claude: investing alerts, learning-to-action plans, homeschool curriculum, travel itineraries, finance/curriculum dashboards

tools.name: Claude
tools.detail: Used for research, planning, and building dashboards

claims: They pick a stock, have Claude research expert opinions, set an entry price, and Claude 'notifies us whenever the stock hits that price'
They feed podcast/documentary learnings into Claude to produce action plans
Built a personalised curriculum for their daughter by giving Claude transcripts of YouTube videos from curricula and educational psychologists they admire
Claude builds travel itineraries matched to local events, spots and child-friendly restaurants
Claude built a finance dashboard and a curriculum dashboard their daughter's tutor also uses to track assessments
how_to_steps: Investing: choose an investment, ask Claude to summarise expert views, decide an entry price, get alerted at that price
Learning: paste podcast/doc content into Claude and ask for an implementation action plan
Curriculum: collect YouTube transcripts of admired educators, feed to Claude, ask for a personalised curriculum
Travel: give Claude dates/location/child constraints and ask for an itinerary
Dashboards: ask Claude to build a finance dashboard and a curriculum-tracking dashboard shared with a tutor
on_screen_only: Title card: 'How we use Claude — as a family building wealth'
Numbered section labels: 1 Investing, 2 Learning, 3 Our Curriculum, 4 Travel, 5 Dashboards
No UI, prompts, or products shown — talking-head only

relevance.why: Consumer/lifestyle use; nothing about building apps or Claude Code. Mild signal that 'ask Claude to build me a dashboard' is now a mainstream expectation.

implement_score.why: The only reusable idea is a Claude-built personal finance/KPI dashboard, which the founder can already do. The 'stock price alert' claim is not something Claude does natively and would need a separate alerting tool.

verify: How does Claude 'notify' them of a stock price — a scheduled task, a third-party app, or exaggeration?
Are the dashboards Claude artifacts or deployed apps?
